== Build notes: 2008 result and bounded source corrections ==

Added 4th in the Sunday consolation on 6 January 2008, with format [[Premiere - Original VS14]], from the numbered final list.<ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=18322#p254691 Sunday consolation results], Players Committee Forums.</ref> Existing deck links, card credits and categories remain.

== Possibly faulty data ==

=== Tournament finishes ===
Four older finish cells have been left blank because the checked sources do not establish the former placing values:
* 2017 US Nationals 23 was a position in the unnumbered first-name-ordered remainder after the explicitly numbered top eight. The historical index confirms Michael Tomashewski's BHBM/Jakku CP(V) decks, not 23rd.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20261020044435/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/tournament-decklists.html Historical PC tournament-decklist index], preserved source captured 13 October 2026, 2017 US Nationals Day 1 section.</ref>
* 2017 MPC 60 was a position in the surname-alphabetical Day 1 deck list, not numbered standings.<ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/match-play-championship/ 2017 MPC], Players Committee.</ref>
* 2015 MPC 28 was a position in an unnumbered nonalphabetical Day 1 deck list; no explicit finishing-place label was found in the checked body.<ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-match-play-championship/ 2015 MPC], Players Committee.</ref>
* 2014 Philadelphia 22 was not supported by the checked individual PC deck post, which leaves its Record field blank.<ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-philadelphia-premiere-event-mike-tomashewski-ls-profit/ Mike Tomashewski LS Profit], Players Committee.</ref> The cached event forum commentary says results were entered into a Google document but does not supply a readable final standings table. No rank is inferred from the list order. The event and deck row remains, in its existing Open format.

The exact earlier values remain in [[Special:PermanentLink/260582|revision 260582]] and its independently backed text/provenance ledger. Blanking these values means that their finish evidence is unresolved, not that the placings have been proven false.

=== Service dates ===
The recovered announcement, posted 27 September 2012, names Mike Tomashewski (Shewski) the latest Design Advocate. It does not establish the former September 2016 end date. The service row now records the dated appointment announcement rather than asserting an unsupported tenure end or an ongoing tenure.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003453/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=346&catid=1&Itemid=117 The Changing Of The Guard], Rogue4, 27 September 2012; exact historical replay retrieved from its 21 February 2013 capture.</ref>

=== Historical copy provenance ===
The old 2012 SoCal and 2013 MPC download-origin byte identities remain unproven. The article now cites the actual independently backed readable Wiki copies that were checked: SoCal p. 25 and MPC p. 100.<ref>[[:File:2012 SoCal Grand Prix.pdf|2012 SoCal historical copy]], p. 25.</ref><ref>[[:File:2013 Match Play Championship.pdf|2013 MPC historical copy]], p. 100.</ref> No alias or current-origin byte equality is asserted for those older download paths. Their original locators are retained in the exact earlier revision and private source ledger.

The 2014 Nationals Day 1 row formerly cited a Day 2 PDF. The actual Day 1 download, native Wiki copy and independent Git copy match, and page 2 names Mike and Separatist Uprising.<ref>[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Nationals-2014-day-1.pdf 2014 Nationals Day 1 decklists], p. 2.</ref> The 2010 Worlds Day 2 row now cites its proven original PDF directly, page 111, rather than a general forum index.<ref>[http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2010/2010+Worlds+D2.pdf 2010 Worlds Day 2 decklists], p. 111.</ref> The current PC decklist catalogue remains a general External link, not proof of the disputed finishes.

The historical 2012 announcement and 2026 index replays are checked historical payloads, not assumed identical to current primary pages. Native copies, source objects and exact revisions are independently backed and centrally registered. Captures remain pending under the existing owner; this is eligible publication, not a declaration of complete preservation.
